Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 110. Category: feat. Saiyan Feats.

Requires: Super Saiyan 4 and Saiyan Elite Feat.
You no longer need to make control checks for using
Super Saiyan while using Great Ape. While using Great
Ape you may now use Super Saiyan 2 but make Berserk
Checks at disadvantage while it is active.
